Court Closure: Half Day Friday
Published on District of Utah (https://www.utb.uscourts.gov)
    
The Court will be closed for a staff meeting at noon on Friday, Aug 28th, 2015 and will remain closed for
the rest of the day. We'll be back in the office on Monday, Aug 31st, 2015.
Published: Monday, August 24, 2015 - 12:28
